# Eden guest ABI reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/abi/abigen.py from abi/idl/*.json - do not edit; change the IDL and regenerate -->

The rules behind these tables are in `ABI.md`.

## World `abi_selftest` v1

The eden_game world plus the abi_test package and exports of every argument type: the round-trip guest of the ABI test suite.

Extends `eden_game`.

Packages: `abi_test`.

| Export | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selftest_run_imports() -> i32` | yes | Calls every import of abi_test and eden_core with known values and checks the answers; returns the number of mismatches. |
| `selftest_take_str(s: str) -> i32` | yes | Returns the byte length of s plus 1000 * its first byte (0 when empty). |
| `selftest_take_bytes(b: bytes) -> i32` | yes | Returns the sum of the bytes of b. |
| `selftest_scalars(a: i32, b: i64, c: f32, d: f64, e: bool) -> f64` | yes | Returns a + b + c + d + (e ? 1 : 0) as f64. |
| `selftest_i64(v: i64) -> i64` | yes | Returns v * 3. |
| `selftest_f32(v: f32) -> f32` | yes | Returns v * 0.5. |
| `selftest_trap() -> i32` | yes | Calls abi_test.fail, which traps; never returns normally. |
| `selftest_bad_pointer(which: i32) -> i32` | yes | Passes a bad argument to an import: 0 = a str range past linear memory, 1 = bytes with a negative length, 2 = a str holding a NUL byte. Each must trap in the host wrapper. |
| `selftest_storage() -> i32` | yes | Exercises eden_storage directly (every error code but ERR_FULL and ERR_IO) and through the libc file modes (w, r, a, remove); leaves the blob `keep` (5 bytes: keep!) behind. Returns the number of mismatches. |
| `selftest_blob_size(name: str) -> i32` | yes | eden_storage.size of the blob as the guest sees it. |
| `selftest_reenter() -> i32` | yes | Calls abi_test.record("reenter"); the host implementation tries to call back into the guest there. |
| `selftest_missing() -> i32` | no | Not implemented by the guest on purpose: an optional export the host must see as absent. |


## World `eden_game` v1

A real-time program (game, emulator, demo) driven frame by frame by an Eden host.

Packages: `eden_core`, `eden_asset`, `eden_video`, `eden_input`, `eden_audio`, `eden_storage`.

| Export | Required | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eden_abi_version() -> i32` | yes | The world version the guest was built for. |
| `eden_alloc(size: i32) -> i32` | yes | Allocates size bytes in linear memory; 0 on failure. |
| `eden_free(ptr: i32) -> void` | yes | Frees a pointer from eden_alloc; 0 is ignored. |
| `eden_init() -> i32` | yes | Prepares the guest; 0 = ready, other values are the guest's error codes. |
| `eden_step(budget_us: i32) -> i32` | yes | Works for about budget_us microseconds of host time; returns STEP_* flags. |
| `eden_shutdown() -> void` | yes | Releases everything; the instance is destroyed after it. |
| `eden_state_size() -> i32` | no | Bytes needed by eden_state_save now. |
| `eden_state_save(dst: i32, cap: i32) -> i32` | no | Writes the snapshot to guest memory [dst, dst + cap); returns bytes written or a negative error. |
| `eden_state_load(snapshot: bytes) -> i32` | no | Restores a snapshot made by eden_state_save of the same guest build; 0 = ok. |

- `EDEN_GAME_STEP_FRAME = 1`: eden_step: a frame was presented during this step
- `EDEN_GAME_STEP_QUIT = 2`: eden_step: the guest wants to stop
- `EDEN_GAME_STEP_ERROR = 4`: eden_step: the guest failed and logged why

## Package `abi_test` v1

Test-only package: one import per ABI type, used by the self-test guest to prove marshalling in both directions. Never offered to a real guest.

| Import | Doc |
| --- | --- |
| `echo_i32(v: i32) -> i32` | Returns v. |
| `echo_i64(v: i64) -> i64` | Returns v. |
| `echo_f32(v: f32) -> f32` | Returns v. |
| `echo_f64(v: f64) -> f64` | Returns v. |
| `negate(v: bool) -> bool` | Returns !v. |
| `mix(a: i32, b: i64, c: f32, d: f64, e: bool) -> f64` | Returns a + b + c + d + (e ? 1 : 0) as f64: arguments of every scalar type in one call. |
| `str_len(s: str) -> i32` | Returns the byte length of s as the host received it. |
| `bytes_sum(b: bytes) -> i32` | Returns the sum of the bytes of b. |
| `fill(dst: outbuf, seed: i32) -> i32` | Writes byte i = (seed + i) & 255 for every i < cap of dst; returns cap. |
| `make_handle(v: i32) -> handle` | Creates a host object holding v; returns its handle. |
| `handle_value(h: handle) -> i32` | Value of the host object, or -1 for a bad handle. |
| `fail() -> void` | Always traps with the message `requested`. |
| `record(s: str) -> void` | Appends the string to the host's call log (the host test reads it). |

- `ABI_TEST_MAGIC = 1234567`: a value both sides know

## Package `eden_asset` v1

Read-only named data files the host makes available to the guest (ROMs, WADs, levels). Names are host-defined keys, not file paths.

| Import | Doc |
| --- | --- |
| `size(name: str) -> i32` | Size of the asset in bytes, or ERR_NOT_FOUND. |
| `read(name: str, offset: i32, dst: outbuf) -> i32` | Copies bytes [offset, offset + cap) of the asset (fewer at its end) into dst. Returns the number of bytes copied, or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_RANGE. |

- `EDEN_ASSET_ERR_NOT_FOUND = -1`: no asset with this name
- `EDEN_ASSET_ERR_RANGE = -2`: offset is negative or past the end of the asset

## Package `eden_audio` v1

Streaming PCM output. The guest opens a stream and pushes interleaved samples; the host plays them in order.

| Import | Doc |
| --- | --- |
| `open(rate: i32, channels: i32) -> handle` | Opens a stream with `channels` (1 or 2) interleaved channels at `rate` Hz. Returns a stream handle (> 0) or ERR_*. |
| `push(stream: handle, samples: bytes, format: i32) -> i32` | Appends samples in `format` (SAMPLE_*). Returns the number of frames queued, or ERR_*. |
| `queued(stream: handle) -> i32` | Frames pushed but not yet played, as far as the host can tell (for back-pressure); ERR_HANDLE for a bad handle. |
| `close(stream: handle) -> void` | Stops and releases the stream. A bad handle is ignored. |

- `EDEN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_S16 = 0`: signed 16-bit little-endian
- `EDEN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_F32 = 1`: 32-bit float in [-1, 1]
- `EDEN_AUDIO_SAMPLE_U8 = 2`: unsigned 8-bit, 128 = silence
- `EDEN_AUDIO_MIN_RATE = 8000`: lowest sample rate
- `EDEN_AUDIO_MAX_RATE = 192000`: highest sample rate
- `EDEN_AUDIO_ERR_ARGS = -1`: rate or channel count out of range, unknown format, or samples not a whole number of frames
- `EDEN_AUDIO_ERR_HANDLE = -2`: not an open stream of this instance
- `EDEN_AUDIO_ERR_UNAVAILABLE = -3`: the host has no audio output

## Package `eden_core` v1

Logging, the host clock and fatal errors.

| Import | Doc |
| --- | --- |
| `log(level: i32, message: str) -> void` | Writes one line to the host console. level is one of LOG_*; other values are treated as LOG_INFO. |
| `time_us() -> i64` | Monotonic host time in microseconds since the instance was created. |
| `abort(message: str) -> void` | Stops the guest: the running export call fails with this message and the instance becomes faulted. |

- `EDEN_CORE_LOG_DEBUG = 0`: diagnostic detail
- `EDEN_CORE_LOG_INFO = 1`: normal messages
- `EDEN_CORE_LOG_WARN = 2`: something is off but the guest continues
- `EDEN_CORE_LOG_ERROR = 3`: the guest failed an operation

## Package `eden_input` v1

Input state sampled by the host once per host frame. Buttons are a device-independent pad the host maps from keyboard and gamepad; keys are PC set-1 scan codes (the values of DirectInput DIK_* and of Eden's KeyCode).

| Import | Doc |
| --- | --- |
| `buttons(pad: i32) -> i32` | Held buttons of pad `pad` (0 = the first player) as a BUTTON_* mask; 0 for a pad that does not exist. |
| `key_down(scancode: i32) -> bool` | Whether the key with this set-1 scan code is held; false outside 1..MAX_SCANCODE. |
| `mouse_buttons() -> i32` | Held mouse buttons as a MOUSE_* mask. |
| `mouse_delta(axis: i32) -> f32` | Movement of the mouse along AXIS_* since the previous host frame, in pixels (wheel: notches); 0 for an unknown axis. |

- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_A = 1`: pad button A
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_B = 2`: pad button B
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_SELECT = 4`: pad button Select
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_START = 8`: pad button Start
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_RIGHT = 16`: d-pad right
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_LEFT = 32`: d-pad left
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_UP = 64`: d-pad up
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_DOWN = 128`: d-pad down
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_X = 256`: pad button X
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_Y = 512`: pad button Y
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_L = 1024`: left shoulder
- `EDEN_INPUT_BUTTON_R = 2048`: right shoulder
- `EDEN_INPUT_MOUSE_LEFT = 1`: left mouse button
- `EDEN_INPUT_MOUSE_RIGHT = 2`: right mouse button
- `EDEN_INPUT_MOUSE_MIDDLE = 4`: middle mouse button
- `EDEN_INPUT_AXIS_X = 0`: horizontal mouse axis
- `EDEN_INPUT_AXIS_Y = 1`: vertical mouse axis, positive down
- `EDEN_INPUT_AXIS_WHEEL = 2`: mouse wheel
- `EDEN_INPUT_MAX_SCANCODE = 255`: largest scan code key_down accepts

## Package `eden_storage` v1

Persistent named blobs (save games, battery RAM, settings) that outlive the instance and the session. The host gives each guest its own namespace; the guest only names blobs inside it. A write replaces the whole blob and is persisted before it returns.

| Import | Doc |
| --- | --- |
| `size(name: str) -> i32` | Size of the blob in bytes, or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_NAME. |
| `read(name: str, offset: i32, dst: outbuf) -> i32` | Copies bytes [offset, offset + cap) of the blob (fewer at its end) into dst. Returns the number of bytes copied, or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_RANGE / ERR_NAME. |
| `write(name: str, data: bytes) -> i32` | Replaces the blob with data (creating it) and persists it. Returns OK or ERR_FULL / ERR_IO / ERR_NAME. |
| `remove(name: str) -> i32` | Deletes the blob and persists the change. Returns OK or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_IO / ERR_NAME. |

- `EDEN_STORAGE_MAX_NAME = 64`: longest blob name in bytes
- `EDEN_STORAGE_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 3145728`: all blobs of a namespace together (the Eden host keeps a namespace in one engine storage of at most 5 MB, base64-encoded)
- `EDEN_STORAGE_OK = 0`: success
- `EDEN_STORAGE_ERR_NOT_FOUND = -1`: no blob with this name
- `EDEN_STORAGE_ERR_RANGE = -2`: offset is negative or past the end of the blob
- `EDEN_STORAGE_ERR_FULL = -3`: the write would take the namespace past MAX_TOTAL_BYTES
- `EDEN_STORAGE_ERR_IO = -4`: the host could not persist the change (engine storage limits or errors); the previous content is kept
- `EDEN_STORAGE_ERR_NAME = -5`: the name is empty or longer than MAX_NAME

## Package `eden_video` v1

A software framebuffer the host shows as a texture.

| Import | Doc |
| --- | --- |
| `present(pixels: bytes, width: i32, height: i32, stride: i32, format: i32) -> i32` | Shows a frame. stride is the distance between rows in bytes. The host copies the pixels before returning. Returns OK or ERR_*. |
| `set_palette(colors: bytes) -> i32` | Sets the palette for FORMAT_INDEXED8: up to 256 RGBA8 entries. Missing entries are opaque black. Returns OK or ERR_PALETTE. |

- `EDEN_VIDEO_FORMAT_RGBA8 = 0`: 4 bytes per pixel in memory order R, G, B, A
- `EDEN_VIDEO_FORMAT_RGB565 = 1`: 2 bytes per pixel, little-endian, red in the high 5 bits
- `EDEN_VIDEO_FORMAT_INDEXED8 = 2`: 1 byte per pixel, an index into the palette set with set_palette
- `EDEN_VIDEO_MAX_WIDTH = 4096`: largest accepted width
- `EDEN_VIDEO_MAX_HEIGHT = 4096`: largest accepted height
- `EDEN_VIDEO_OK = 0`: success
- `EDEN_VIDEO_ERR_FORMAT = -1`: unknown format
- `EDEN_VIDEO_ERR_SIZE = -2`: width, height or stride out of range, or pixels shorter than stride * height
- `EDEN_VIDEO_ERR_PALETTE = -3`: palette is not a whole number of RGBA8 entries, is empty, or has more than 256
